name: Create GitHub Issue from Bug
description: Scans code/logs for bugs and creates GitHub issue with proper template, labels, and priority

variables.name: bugDescription
variables.description: Optional bug description. If not provided, will scan for bugs.

tasks.description: Scan codebase and logs for potential bugs

prompt.template:
Scan the codebase for potential bugs:

{{#if errorLog}}
Error logs:
```
{{errorLog}}
```
{{/if}}

1. Use glob to find source files
2. Use grep to search for common bug patterns (TODO, FIXME, console.error, throw new Error)
3. Check for uncaught exceptions
4. Look for type errors

Identify the most critical bug to create an issue for.

tasks.description: Create GitHub issue using gh CLI
Add issue to GitHub project board

command.run: ISSUE_NUM=$(echo '{{create-issue.output}}' | grep -oP 'issues/\K\d+') && gh project item-add 1 --owner @me --content-id $ISSUE_NUM || true

produces.description: Created GitHub issue with URL and number
